note: Fixed category codes. The model may describe topic-specific misconceptions, but each must map to one of these codes so the class heatmap can aggregate them.

categories.description: A plus/minus sign or a direction was flipped.
Units were not converted, or were converted wrongly.
Used a related but wrong formula, or swapped its parts.
categories.example: Speed = distance x time instead of distance / time.
Multiplied when the problem needed division.

categories.description: Mixed up two related ideas or terms.
categories.example: Confused mass with weight, or area with perimeter.

categories.description: Stopped one step early or skipped a step.
categories.example: Found the discount but not the final price.

categories.description: Answered a different question than the one asked.
categories.example: Gave the total when the question asked for the difference.

categories.description: Applied a rule outside the cases where it is true.
categories.example: Thought multiplying always makes a number bigger.
